findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Test. The concurrent land test still writes `review-starts.jsonl` with an unlocked append at line 146. Two closes start reviewers concurrently, so on Windows one write can overwrite the other; `_in_close` then lacks a review start and the test fails. This log was not covered by the new locking helper, despite the ruling that concurrent stub logs were serialized.
